name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 2 – Am 50
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 2. Calls for the 2028-2034 MFF to be implemented with strict budgetary discipline and without any automatic increase in the own resources ceilings, and to ensure that additional spending is carried out only if it delivers clear European added value and does not place any permanent burden on the national budgets;
